source.title: Letter to Origen
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letter to Origen (Africanus)

paragraphs.text: Greeting, my lord and son, most worthy Origen, from Africanus. In your sacred discussion with Agnomon you referred to that prophecy of Daniel which is related of his youth. This at that time, as was meet, I accepted as genuine. Now, however, I cannot understand how it escaped you that this part of the book is spurious. For, in truth, this section, although apart from this it is elegantly written, is plainly a more modern forgery. There are many proofs of this. When Susanna is condemned to die, the prophet is seized by the Spirit, and cries out that the sentence is unjust. Now, in the first place, it is always in some other way that Daniel prophesies— by visions, and dreams, and an angel appearing to him, never by prophetic inspiration. Then, after crying out in this extraordinary fashion, he detects them in a way no less incredible, which not even Philistion the play-writer would have resorted to. For, not satisfied with rebuking them through the Spirit, he placed them apart, and asked them severally where they saw her committing adultery. And when the one said, Under a holm-tree (prinos ), he answered that the angel would saw him asunder (prisein ); and in a similar fashion menaced the other who said, Under a mastich-tree (schinos ), with being rent asunder (schisthenai ). Now, in Greek, it happens that holm-tree and saw asunder, and rend and mastich-tree sound alike; but in Hebrew they are quite distinct. But all the books of the Old Testament have been translated from Hebrew into Greek.

2. Moreover, how is it that they who were captives among the Chaldæans, lost and won at play, thrown out unburied on the streets, as was prophesied of the former captivity, their sons torn from them to be eunuchs, and their daughters to be concubines, as had been prophesied; how is it that such could pass sentence of death, and that on the wife of their king Joakim, whom the king of the Babylonians had made partner of his throne? Then if it was not this Joakim, but some other from the common people, whence had a captive such a mansion and spacious garden? But a more fatal objection is, that this section, along with the other two at the end of it, is not contained in the Daniel received among the Jews. And add that, among all the many prophets who had been before, there is no one who has quoted from another word for word. For they had no need to go a-begging for words, since their own were true; but this one, in rebuking one of those men, quotes the words of the Lord: <quote>The innocent and righteous shall you not slay.</quote> From all this I infer that this section is a later addition. Moreover, the style is different. I have struck the blow; do you give the echo; answer, and instruct me. Salute all my masters. The learned all salute you. With all my heart I pray for your and your circle's health.

latex.p0003: 问候，我主和儿子，最可敬的\Person{奥力振}，来自\Person{阿非利加诺}。在与\Person{阿诺蒙}的神圣讨论中，你提到了\Person{达尼尔}关于他青年时期的预言。那时，我认为它是真实的。但现在，我无法理解你怎会忽略这本书的这一部分是伪造的。事实上，虽然除这一点外，这部分写得优雅，但明显是更晚的伪作。有许多证据。当\Person{苏撒纳}被判死刑时，先知被圣神抓住，呼喊判决不公。首先，\Person{达尼尔}总是以其他方式预言——通过异象、梦境和天使显现，从未通过先知灵感。然后，以这种非凡方式呼喊后，他以同样难以置信的方式揭露他们，连剧作家\Person{斐利斯提昂}也不会采用。因为他不满足于通过圣神斥责他们，而是将他们分开，分别问他们在哪里看见她通奸。一个说\Quote{在圣木下}（\OriginalTerm{圣木}{prinos}），他回答说天使会将他\OriginalTerm{锯开}{prisein}；同样地，另一人说\Quote{在乳香树下}（\OriginalTerm{乳香树}{schinos}），他威胁说要被\OriginalTerm{撕裂}{schisthenai}。在希腊文中，巧合的是，\Quote{圣木}和\Quote{锯开}，\Quote{撕裂}和\Quote{乳香树}发音相似；但在希伯来文中完全不同。但旧约全书都是从希伯来文译成希腊文。
latex.p0004: 2. 此外，他们是在加色丁人中的俘虏，被输赢，被抛在街上无人埋葬，如同先前被掳时所预言的，他们的儿子被夺去当太监，女儿当妾，正如所预言的；他们怎能判处死刑，而且是针对他们的君王\Person{约雅金}之妻，巴比伦王曾使她与他同坐王位？如果不是\Person{约雅金}，而是另一个平民，那么一个俘虏怎能拥有如此豪宅和宽敞的花园？但更致命的异议是，这一部分，连同末尾的其他两部分，不在犹太人接受的\BibleBook{达尼尔}{书}中。此外，在以前许多先知中，没有人逐字引用过别人的话。因为他们无需乞求话语，因为他们自己的话语是真实的；但这人在斥责其中一人时，引用了主的话：\BibleQuote{不可杀害无辜和义人。}由此我推断这一部分是后来增补的。而且文体也不同。我已出击，请你回应；回答我，教导我。请问候我所有师长。有学问的人都问候你。我全心祈祷你和你的同人健康。
